overview_description.description:
Fibr is a cutting-edge AI-powered platform designed to tackle the escalating challenge of customer acquisition costs (CAC) in a rapidly evolving digital landscape. As third-party cookies are phased out and privacy regulations become more stringent, traditional marketing methods are increasingly insufficient for driving down CAC and maximizing ROI. Fibr addresses this issue with its advanced personalization solutions, which enhance the effectiveness of every marketing interaction.

The company's Web Pilot is an innovative tool that generates personalized, landing pages for every ad, email, and communication. This technology ensures that each user interaction is tailored to individual preferences and behaviors, significantly improving engagement and conversion rates. By providing a personalized experience across all touchpoints, Fibr helps businesses optimize their marketing spend and reduce CAC effectively.

Complementing Web Pilot is Fibr’s AI Blocks, which simplifies adapting and repurposing successful content across different formats and channels. This tool ensures that marketing messages remain relevant and compelling, whether used in ads, social media posts, or emails. With Fibr, businesses can deliver cohesive, on-brand experiences at scale, streamline content creation, and achieve superior marketing results. By leveraging Fibr’s AI-driven personalization, companies can navigate the challenges of a cookie-less future and drive down CAC, making their marketing efforts more efficient and impactful.

about_short_description.short_description: Fibr is an AI-powered personalization platform that helps brands improve conversion rates.

product.name: Agentic Web Experience Platform
product.description: An AI-powered platform that turns existing website URLs into adaptive web experiences that detect visitor intent and dynamically personalize page content in real time.

product.name: AI Landing Page Creator
product.description: A no-code tool for generating and deploying personalized, on-brand landing pages and page variants at scale using AI.

product.name: Experimentation Suite
product.description: An AI-driven experimentation product that creates hypotheses and page variants, allocates traffic, monitors statistical significance, and continuously optimizes web experiences.

product.name: Ad Personalization
product.description: A campaign personalization capability that matches landing page content to individual advertisements and search intent to improve post-click relevance and conversion performance.

product.name: Journey Personalization
product.description: A multi-page personalization capability that preserves visitor context across a funnel and adapts subsequent pages based on previous interactions and intent.

product.name: Audience Personalization
product.description: A no-code capability for delivering different landing page experiences to audience segments defined through analytics data and custom visitor signals.
